notes: Nill Download Manager 1.9.1 — a fixes release from a full audit of the app and the browser extension, every fix re-verified in live use. The Scheduler now starts Download Later files placed in a scheduled queue (before, they never started at all) and no longer pauses a download immediately after a schedule edit. Direct audio files are labelled with their real format, e.g. Audio Only (M4A). Deleting, cancelling and pause-resume no longer leave journal or partial files behind, and an errored download is recognised by the duplicate check so Retry resumes the same entry. The app also carries its full name from this release: Nill Download Manager.
